title: The Trench-Floor Compression Vault

features.name: sediment-closure
features.desc-on-touch: The weight of everything above has compressed this place into shapes that predate names. You feel the pressure of islands stacked on islands, all their stories pressed into mineral silence.

features.name: archive-sealing
features.desc-on-touch: Writing that has been compressed beyond readability, layers of sediment turned to stone, meaning erased by time and pressure into pure storage.

features.name: pressure-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Mineral-dense water that has learned to hold the shapes of what it once carried. No current moves it. No light reaches into it.

features.name: crushed-signal
features.desc-on-touch: Where the broadcast casings have been compressed into the rock itself. The archive still tries to transmit at 300 bits per second from a place that stopped meaning anything.

inscription: at the trench-floor what archives wanted to mean has been compressed into mineral silence

file.note: Sediment layers recording island stories as they were pressed into bedrock; each entry shorter than the last, until only depth remains
